messages:
alyssa: quick ping — PR #2567 has the rename sweep (ClientID -> client_id) and a tiny proto tag change. can someone give a fast review?
juan: looks reasonable at a glance. golangci-lint is failing on the generated proto import order though.
alyssa: ah, I ran the formatter but missed the import ordering. running `gofmt` + `goimports` now.
marta: one stylistic nit: in handler_test.go you changed 'reqID' -> 'requestID' in one place but left 'req_id' in asserts. prefer consistent snake_case in serialized fields.
alyssa: good catch — that was an assert mismatch. I'll fix to `request_id` in the fixture expectations.
dev-bot: CI update: build #3421 failed — golangci-lint: sorting imports (goimports) required.
juan: after imports fix ping me, I'll do a quick proto tag sanity check (was worried about tag 3 -> 4 rename).
sam: if it's just renames + import order I'm happy to approve once CI passes. @alyssa please squash the small formatting commits into the rename commit.
alyssa: squashed and pushed (force). also updated CHANGELOG entry to "naming: normalize client_id/request_id (PR #2567)". PTAL @juan @sam :thumbsup:
juan: left a tiny comment inline about keeping the old proto json name via `json_name` in one proto field. not required for merge but worth considering for backwards compatibility.
marta: that proto json_name nit would break some old cached payloads, so if we skip it now we should add a rollout note to the dedupe cache invalidation task.
alyssa: ok, I'll open a follow-up task for cache invalidation and reference this PR. moving forward with merge after CI green. thanks everyone.
mergebot: PR #2567 merged into main by alyssa — deploy queued for next maintenance window. :rocket:
juan: thanks! can we add a one-sentence note in the release notes about the naming normalization so infra teams know to watch metrics?
alyssa: will do — adding brief note before release.
